about: A Mannheim Road steak-and-cocktails house that says it opened in 1986 and is now marking 40 years. Stacy's built its name on premium cuts, broiled seafood and hand-made drinks, with every dinner starting with its baked onion soup in a crock.
tagline: Prime cuts, onion soup in a crock and a proper cocktail.
signature: Feta Cheese, Olives and Tomatoes with Grecian dressing
hours: Mon–Thu 4:00 PM–10:00 PM; Fri–Sat 4:00 PM–11:00 PM; Sun closed ("Working Hours" footer on stacyscafe.com, fetched 2026-11-10)
notes: HOURS CONFLICT: trail data has Mon–Thu 11–10, Fri 11–11, Sat 4–11 with lunch; the official site lists dinner only from 4 PM Mon–Sat (MapQuest agrees). FOUNDING YEAR: site says established 1986 / '40 years'; third-party listings (MapQuest, naicslist) say 1965 — use the site's 1986. Site also lists email info@stacyscafe.com and says catering/private events are offered. Many dish images on the site are AI-generated or AI-retouched (ChatGPT/Gemini filenames and restyled versions of phone photos) and were deliberately NOT used; the site's Instagram link points to a single post, no confirmed official Facebook/Instagram page found.
